title: Lumun language
text: Lumun, also known as Kuku-Lumun or Lomon, is a Niger–Congo language of the Talodi subgroup within the Kordofanian branch, spoken by an estimated 19,000 people primarily in the Nuba Mountains of South Kordofan state, Sudan.
